name: Cumulative distribution function (CDF)
definition_zh: 描述随机变量不超过给定取值的累积概率的函数。
definition_en: A function giving the accumulated probability up to a specified value of a random variable.
usage_overview: 在轨道随机分析中，常用于建立不平顺谱值、随机参数或退化增量与累积概率的对应关系，再借助逆函数进行随机取值、代表性谱线选取或预测分位值确定；也用于比较不同工况下沉降不超过指定水平的概率。

complete_examples.text: To the actual random variables z υ, which are assumed to follow an already known probability density function (PDF) f Z (z υ) , the cumulative distribution function (CDF), a monotonic function, can be derived by F Z (z υ) = z υ −∞ f Z (z υ) d z υ, υ = 1 , 2 , .

The probability density function (PDF) of track irregularities at the frequency f can be characterised by p(̃GGeo(f)) with cumulative distribution function (CDF) P(̃GGeo(f)), where ̃GGeo(f) is a vector representing the PSD range of the track irregularity against frequency f . Obviously, the mean value of PSD with respect to frequency f can be expressed by μGeo(f) = ̃p(̃GGeo(f)) · ̃GGeo(f) (18) with ̃p(̃GGeo(f)) = p(̃GGeo(f)) ̃GGeo(f), where ̃GGeo(f) is the PSD interval of the PDF function; the dot ‘·’ denotes the dot product.
